page.overview:
What is Discharge Nozzle?

Discharge Nozzles were components used on weapons such as the Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer and flamethrowers. Four Discharge Nozzles were located just behind the paddle beamer's Beam Emitter. On flamethrowers, such as the Model C-22 flame carbine and Model CR-24 flame rifle, the Discharge Nozzles were used to project the flame from the weapon.

The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology
